herbFaq.heading: Frequently asked questions
herbFaq.knownAs: {name} ({scientific}) is known in English as {commons}. It is traditionally used for {uses}.
herbFaq.usedForAnswer: {name} ({scientific}) is traditionally used for {uses}. Always consult a healthcare professional before use.
herbFaq.pregSafe: {name} is generally considered safe during pregnancy, but always consult your healthcare provider.
herbFaq.pregCaution: {name} should be used with caution during pregnancy. Consult your healthcare provider before use.
herbFaq.pregUnsafe: {name} is not recommended during pregnancy. Consult your healthcare provider for alternatives.
herbFaq.pregUnknown: The safety of {name} during pregnancy has not been conclusively established. Consult your healthcare provider before use.
herbFaq.interactSome: Yes, {name} has {count, plural, one {# known drug interaction} other {# known drug interactions}}. {notes}
herbFaq.interactFallbackNotes: Consult your healthcare provider or pharmacist about potential interactions with your medications.
herbFaq.interactNone: No drug interactions are currently listed in HerbAlly's curated interaction table for {name}. Absence from this table does not mean absence of risk — always check with your pharmacist or prescriber before combining any herb with prescription or OTC medicines.
herbFaq.sideEffects: What are the side effects of {name}?
herbFaq.sideEffectsFallback: Reported side effects vary by preparation and dose. Consult a qualified healthcare provider or pharmacist before using {name}.
herbFaq.sideEffectsDangerous: {name} is a toxic or potentially lethal plant. Do not self-administer; contact Poison Control or emergency services immediately if exposed.
herbFaq.doseQuestion: How do I check the adult reference dose for {name}?
herbFaq.doseAnswer: Use HerbAlly's free adult (18+) monograph reference tool to review the established unscaled adult reference amount for {name}. Never exceed monograph maximums, and confirm dosing with a healthcare provider.

herbHero.evidenceScopeNote: Overall grade reflects the strongest cited indication — evidence varies by use and preparation; review each source section below.

provenance.aiSummarizedTooltip: Summarized by AI. See the citations block for the underlying sources.
provenance.primarySourceTooltip: Cites a primary source. Not yet manually reviewed.
provenance.notHumanReviewedTooltip: This entry has not been human-reviewed. Do not treat it as a verified monograph.
provenance.humanReviewedTooltip: Reviewed and verified against the listed sources ({reviewer}, {date}). Editorial review, not clinical review.
provenance.bulkEditorialImportTooltip: Bulk editorial provenance stamp ({reviewer}, {date}). Not an individual clinical review.
provenance.needsReReviewTooltip: This page was reviewed before and has changed since. Treat it as unreviewed until someone reads it again.
provenance.unverifiedTooltip: This entry was generated by AI and has not yet been verified against primary sources. Cross-check with a qualified healthcare provider before relying on this information.
provenance.sourceVerifiedTooltip: Cross-checked against {count} independent sources: {sources}. This confirms the plant identity and its regulator record — it is not a claim that a person has read this page.
provenance.identityVerifiedTooltip: The plant's name is confirmed by {count} independent taxonomic sources ({sources}). No government regulator has published a monograph for this herb, so nothing beyond its identity is claimed here.
provenance.formulaTooltip: This entry is a multi-herb product, not a single plant, so there is no botanical name to cross-check. Its ingredients are listed on the page; the formula itself has no taxonomic identity.
provenance.nonPlantTooltip: This entry is a mineral, animal product, vitamin or isolate, not a plant. There is no botanical name to cross-check, and its record is presented as a materia medica entry.

pubmedSheet.compiledTitle: Supplemental AI-compiled PubMed research summary (independent of top profile checks)
pubmedSheet.compiledBody: Separate from any top-of-page identity or regulatory source check, this supplemental section summarizes selected PubMed (NIH) abstracts using AI assistance and has NOT been human-reviewed. Verify claims directly in PubMed and consult a healthcare provider before use.
pubmedSheet.reviewedBody: This sheet was compiled from PubMed (NIH) abstracts and has been human-reviewed. Every claim is cited to a real PubMed article (see the source list).
pubmedSheet.languageNote: This compiled sheet is in English because the PubMed studies it cites are in English.
